architecture.crop_source: first 128 columns of production V21 tight/context proposal encoding
architecture.proposal_and_role_heads: separate binary proposal and eight-role heads
architecture.scene_context: eight learned role queries pool permutation-invariant anchors over fused proposal representations; each proposal also receives scene mean and maximum

protocol.data_scope: fresh project-owned procedural graph scenes only; no Chandler, Generalization, private or article images, external datasets, pretrained calibrator weights, or predecessor fixture bytes
protocol.defect_class: V23 P1 and proposal-head-only P3 retained the same three false and prohibited regions while preserving all 1024 truths, indicating that the 31 aggregate evidence values cannot distinguish the remaining structures
protocol.isolated_change: train a new project-owned model from scratch that fuses each proposal's production tight and context raster crops with the existing 31 evidence values before the unchanged role-anchor set context and separate proposal and role heads

training.proposal_objective: class-balanced cross entropy plus scene-extrema margin
training.role_objective: class-balanced cross entropy over every positive proposal
